correctness.rationale: Poisson superposition and conditional expectation rigorously give Cov(T,C)=n Cov(tau,C). The marked-type law and beta-twisted exponential density yield an exact all-size moment formula. Strict positivity, unbounded moments, and strict moment log-convexity prove one sign transition. Gamma MGF asymptotics and explicit uniform integrability give the log n threshold. Independent exact-rational dynamic programming passed 457 assertions for finite n.

Actual semantic published-finding corpus searches found analogous but non-implying sign switches in different random structures. Residual historical implicit coverage remains possible.

value.rationale: The covariance profile of a random stopping duration against the full terminal exact-multiplicity spectrum is a meaningful stopped-occupancy dependence invariant, with a structural strict one-switch theorem and a natural logarithmic-scale sharp threshold. Unlike covered fixed-frequency marginal or singleton results, it explains how low-frequency coupon types and highly repeated types relate oppositely to completion duration.
